404

::: {.nf-card}
```
path: URL-PATH = <this url path here>
found?: URL-PATH -> Bool
found?("404.html") = true
found?(x) = false
#eval(found?(path)) -- => <result>
```
:::
::::

```{=html}
<script>
  (function () {
    const path = decodeURIComponent(window.location.pathname);
    // Mirror the definition above: only "404.html" itself is found.
    const found = /(^|\/)404\.html$/.test(path);
    const code = document.querySelector("#notfound .nf-card pre code");
    code.textContent = code.textContent
      .replace("<this url path here>", JSON.stringify(path))
      .replace("<result>", String(found));
  })();
</script>
```
